KLOW.subtitle: The KLOW Blend
KLOW.summary: KLOW is a combination of four peptides — GHK-Cu, KPV, BPC-157, and TB-500 — currently studied across several research areas involving tissue, immune, and cellular signaling pathways.

ingredients.name: GHK-Cu
ingredients.label: Copper Peptide
ingredients.researchArea: Collagen synthesis signaling, tissue remodeling, antioxidant activity, and angiogenesis pathway research.

ingredients.name: KPV
ingredients.label: Tripeptide
ingredients.researchArea: Inflammatory signaling pathways and immune modulation research.

ingredients.name: BPC-157
ingredients.label: Body Protection Compound
ingredients.researchArea: Musculoskeletal tissue signaling, gastrointestinal tract research, nerve signaling, and angiogenesis pathway research.

ingredients.name: TB-500
ingredients.label: Thymosin Beta-4 Fragment
ingredients.researchArea: Cell migration signaling, tissue repair pathways, and flexibility-related research.

KLOW.consultationNote: Dosing, scheduling, and reconstitution information is reviewed during a consultation.

GLP-3 (retatrutide).summary: Retatrutide is an investigational triagonist peptide studied for its activity at GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon receptors. Researchers are investigating its role in metabolic signaling pathways related to energy regulation.
GLP-3 (retatrutide).researchNote: Investigational compound. Not FDA-approved. Research is ongoing.

Oxytocin.subtitle: Peptide Hormone & Neurotransmitter
Oxytocin.summary: Oxytocin is a naturally occurring neuropeptide and hormone produced in the hypothalamus and released by the pituitary gland. It is studied for its roles across several signaling pathways:

researchAreas.detail: Researchers study oxytocin's interaction with the amygdala and the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis, investigating its role in cortisol regulation and stress-response modulation pathways.
Studies examine its influence on social recognition, trust signaling, and affiliative behavior research in both animal models and human subjects.
Research investigates oxytocin's interaction with serotonin and dopamine pathways and its role in mood-related signaling research.
Studies explore its role in energy balance, appetite-regulating neural pathways, and metabolic signaling research.
Research examines its role in reproductive behavior, arousal-related pathways, and intimacy-related neuroendocrine signaling.
Researchers study oxytocin's interaction with spinal pain-modulation pathways and opioid receptor signaling in the context of pain research.

Oxytocin.researchNote: Naturally occurring hormone; investigational for many of the uses described. Not medical advice.

PT-141.subtitle: Melanocortin Receptor Research Peptide
PT-141.summary: PT-141 (bremelanotide) is a synthetic melanocortin receptor agonist studied for its activity at MC3 and MC4 receptors in the central nervous system. A pharmaceutical version (Vyleesi) received FDA approval for hypoactive sexual desire disorder in premenopausal women. Research covers several signaling areas:

researchAreas.detail: Research focuses on PT-141's activity at MC3 and MC4 receptors and its downstream effects on dopamine and norepinephrine signaling pathways.
Studies examine its role in libido-related neural pathways, sexual arousal signaling, and desire-related CNS activity in both men and women.
Researchers investigate its influence on dopaminergic pathways involved in mood, motivation, and reward-system signaling research.
Studies explore its role in central nervous system activation signaling, alertness pathways, and energy-related neurological research.

PT-141.researchNote: A pharmaceutical version (Vyleesi/bremelanotide) is FDA-approved for HSDD in premenopausal women. PT-141 as a research peptide is investigational. Not medical advice.

Epithalon.summary: Epithalon (Epitalon) is a synthetic tetrapeptide studied for its potential influence on telomerase activity and cellular aging research. It is being investigated in the context of longevity-related signaling pathways.
Epithalon.researchNote: Investigational compound in cellular aging research.

Semax.summary: Semax is a synthetic peptide analog of the ACTH fragment 4–10. Researchers study it for its activity in cognitive signaling and neuroprotective pathway investigations.
Semax.researchNote: Cognitive signaling research; investigational in many regions.

Selank.summary: Selank is a synthetic analog of the immunomodulatory peptide tuftsin. It is studied for its activity in stress-response and anxiety-related signaling pathway research.

Ipamorelin + CJC-1295.summary: This combination pairs a growth hormone releasing peptide (Ipamorelin) with a GHRH analog (CJC-1295). Research focuses on growth hormone secretagogue signaling pathways and their downstream effects on cellular processes.
Ipamorelin + CJC-1295.researchNote: Growth hormone axis research; investigational compounds.

Ipamorelin.summary: Ipamorelin is a selective, third-generation growth hormone secretagogue studied for its activity at GHSR (growth hormone secretagogue receptor) signaling pathways with selectivity research.
Ipamorelin.researchNote: Growth hormone secretagogue research; investigational compound.

CJC-1295.summary: CJC-1295 is a synthetic GHRH (growth hormone releasing hormone) analog studied for its role in growth hormone signaling, extended half-life dynamics, and downstream cellular pathway research.

MOTS-c.summary: MOTS-c is a mitochondria-derived peptide encoded in the mitochondrial genome. It is studied for its role in metabolic signaling, insulin sensitivity research, and mitochondrial-nuclear communication pathways.

SS-31.summary: SS-31 (elamipretide) is a cardiolipin-targeting tetrapeptide studied for its role in mitochondrial membrane function, cellular energy pathway research, and mitochondrial integrity signaling.

Kisspeptin.summary: Kisspeptin is a naturally occurring neuropeptide encoded by the KISS1 gene. It is studied for its central role in reproductive hormone signaling, particularly in the regulation of GnRH release from the hypothalamus.

TA1.summary: Thymosin Alpha-1 (TA1) is a thymic peptide studied for its role in immune modulation research, T-cell signaling pathways, and innate and adaptive immune system interaction.
TA1.researchNote: Immune modulation research; approved in some countries, investigational in others.

NAD+.summary: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) is a coenzyme present in all living cells. It is studied for its role in cellular energy metabolism, DNA repair signaling, sirtuin activation research, and aging-related cellular pathways.

DSIP.summary: Delta Sleep-Inducing Peptide (DSIP) is an investigational neuropeptide studied for its potential role in sleep-regulating signaling pathways and circadian rhythm-related research.

Melatonin.summary: Melatonin is a naturally occurring hormone produced by the pineal gland. It is studied for its role in circadian rhythm regulation, photoperiodic signaling, and antioxidant activity research.

Pinealon.summary: Pinealon is an experimental tripeptide studied in preclinical research for its potential neuroprotective signaling properties and its possible interactions with pineal gland function.
Pinealon.researchNote: Experimental neuropeptide research; limited human data.

ARA-290.summary: ARA-290 (cibinetide) is an erythropoietin-derived peptide studied for its activity at the innate repair receptor. Research explores its role in inflammatory and nerve signaling pathway modulation.
ARA-290.researchNote: Inflammatory and nerve signaling research; investigational compound.

Bromelain.summary: Bromelain is a proteolytic enzyme complex derived from pineapple. It is studied for its activity in inflammatory pathway research, protein digestion, and immune signaling investigations.
Bromelain.researchNote: Supplement topic; dietary enzyme with ongoing research.

Omega-3.summary: Omega-3 fatty acids (EPA and DHA) are essential polyunsaturated fats studied for their roles in inflammatory signaling, cardiovascular pathway research, and neurological function investigations.
Omega-3.researchNote: Supplement topic; widely researched essential fatty acids.

Vitamin C.summary: Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) is an essential water-soluble nutrient studied for its role in antioxidant activity, collagen synthesis pathways, and immune signaling research.
Vitamin C.researchNote: Supplement topic; essential nutrient with broad research.

Selenium.summary: Selenium is an essential trace mineral incorporated into selenoproteins. It is studied for its role in antioxidant enzyme activity, thyroid hormone signaling, and immune function pathway research.

Magnesium.summary: Magnesium is an essential mineral that acts as a cofactor in over 300 enzymatic reactions. It is studied for its role in muscle and nerve signaling, energy metabolism, and DNA synthesis pathway research.
Magnesium.researchNote: Supplement topic; essential mineral with broad research.
